device.description: 16-bit low-power voltage-output DAC with 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface and VFB feedback pin
device.note: dac8531.pdf (SBAS192B) p.3 electrical characteristics (VDD 2.7-5.5 V) and pin description (MSOP-8 and SON-8, same numbering), p.4 timing characteristics and serial write operation, p.12 serial interface, input shift register (Figure 3), SYNC interrupt (Figure 4) and power-on reset to zero, p.13 power-down modes (Table I)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros (p.12)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB17-DB16) of the last valid frame: 00 normal, 01 1 kOhm, 10 100 kOhm, 11 Hi-Z

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB23-DB18 don't care, DB17-DB16 PD1/PD0, DB15-DB0 data MSB first; executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt)

pages: p.3 (specifications, VDD 2.7-5.5 V, pins), p.4 (timing), p.12 (serial interface, input shift register Figure 3, SYNC interrupt, power-on reset), p.13 (power-down Table I)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string, output amplifier and VFB feedback input (VOUT is never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 stored in CTRL.PD only; the DAC register keeps its contents
power-down exit time (2.5 us at 5 V, 5 us at 3 V) and output settling
SCLK frequency (20 MHz below VDD 3.6 V, 30 MHz above) and setup/hold limits t1-t8
SPI mode: data taken on SCLK falling edges, SCLK high at SYNC fall in the timing figure; modeled as mode 2
the SON-8 (DRB) thermal pad is not a pin
variants: dac8531.pdf covers only the DAC8531 in MSOP-8 (DGK) and SON-8 (DRB) with the same pin numbering. DAC8501 (own file) is the multiplying-optimized version.
